Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class BulkPublicationJobService

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.BulkPublicationJobService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean
public final class BulkPublicationJobService extends Object implements org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean
Single-node asynchronous coordinator for namespace-wide bulk publication and reconciliation jobs. Enforces at most one active job per namespace, retains bounded completed history, and surfaces live batch progress alongside persistent V21 audit entries.
